title: 胖宝宝/Fat Baby
description:
Inspired by the Raider and the Onion Knight.

A custom Slay the Spire 2 character mod that weaves in elements from Dark Souls III, Elden Ring, and Elden Ring Nightreign.

This is a beta build and still subject to balance and content changes. Requires the matching version of BaseLib.

If you encounter any bugs, please leave a comment. I’ll try to fix them as soon as I see them. Thank you for your subscribing and enjoy the game!

人物参考：洋葱骑士和无赖

融合了魂三 法环 黑环的很多元素

有bug/建议记得反馈  我会第一时间去修的 谢谢大家 大家游玩开心
